quotes.quote: Microarray data were processed and analyzed in R. By comparing with the IgAN patients and normal individuals, we calculated the differentially expressed mRNA (DE-mRNA) from GSE93798 dataset and different expressed miRNA (DE-miRNAs) from GSE64306 dataset by “limma” package in R.
We adopted CIBERSORT method to determine the proportions of the 22 types of infiltrating immune cells in IgAN patients and normal controls [ 12 ].

G1.rationale: The principal results are produced by re-runnable computations (limma differential expression, CIBERSORT deconvolution) on public GEO microarray data.

quotes.quote: There were 20 DE-miRNAs between IgAN patients and the normal controls. Of these, four DE-miRNAs were downregulated, whereas 16 DE-miRNAs were upregulated.
The results showed 957 downregulated and 834 upregulated genes between the IgAN patients and the normal controls.

G2.rationale: A single principal quantitative result can be named: the count of DE-miRNAs (20 total; 4 down, 16 up) from GSE64306, the first reported numerical endpoint.

quotes.quote: The miRNA expression profile under accession number GSE64306 was contributed by Wang et al. [ 17 ]. The dataset was downloaded from the GEO database according to the platform of the GPL19117 [miRNA-4] Affymetrix Multispecies miRNA-4 Array.

Raw data from the GSE93798 and GSE64306 datasets were read using the “affy” package in R (version 3.5.3, R Core Team, Vienna, Austria). The RMA algorithm was used for background correction and data normalization.

G3.rationale: The deposit lists raw data archives (GSE64306_RAW.tar, GSE93798_RAW.tar) that are the analysis inputs, not outputs.

the p values were adjusted using the Benjamin and Hochberg method, the thresholds were adj. p < 0.05 and logFC > 1 (upregulated) or logFC < − 1 (downregulated).

specification.exact_target: Number of differentially expressed miRNAs (DE-miRNAs) between IgAN patients and normal controls in the GSE64306 urine sediment dataset: 20 total, of which 4 were downregulated and 16 were upregulated.
specification.blind_target: The count of differentially expressed miRNAs identified by comparing IgAN patients with normal controls in the GSE64306 urine sediment miRNA expression dataset, split by direction of change.
specification.target_location: Results, subsection 'DE-miRNA screening in IgAN patients and normal individuals' (Fig. 1a-c)

specification.input_notes: GSE64306 (GPL19117, Affymetrix Multispecies miRNA-4 Array) raw data; 18 IgAN patients and 6 healthy individuals. GSE64306_RAW.tar is the raw archive; filelist.txt is only an index. GSE93798 is not needed for this miRNA target.

leakage_files.name: GSE64306_RAW.tar
leakage_files.reason: Contains the raw CEL files that are the inputs; however, if any processed/derived DE-miRNA result tables were included they would leak the target. The archive itself is the input, not a leak, but any processed supplementary tables derived from it must not be served.

specification.comparison_metric: Exact match of the reported counts (total DE-miRNAs, downregulated, upregulated) to the solver's recomputed counts.
specification.specification_gaps: The paper does not specify the exact limma contrast coding, whether logFC is on log2 scale, the exact multiple-testing correction implementation details, or how ties at the threshold are handled. The number of probes vs. unique miRNAs is not stated.

alternatives_considered.target: Number of DE-mRNAs in GSE93798 (957 down, 834 up)
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because the paper's stated priority is the miRNA-mRNA network and the DE-miRNA count is reported first in Results; also the DE-mRNA count is a secondary endpoint.
